results.title: New Silence
results.overview: A rhythmic portrait of the search for connection between a reclusive drummer and his sister. Overwhelmed by the rumbling vibrations of a fragmented winter landscape, the tormented brother refuses to speak. His sister tries to break his silence by communicating indirectly through audio clips, using her brother’s sound recorder to create an auditive universe for their relationship.

results.title: Amor Eterno
results.overview: Amidst a solar flare phenomenon, two recently separated lovers seek to reconcile their relationship by revisiting their favourite pastime of karaoke.

results.title: Touch of Tim
results.overview: Last year, Tim Rangström—also known as "Sporttouchen"—gathered a host of famous personalities for an unexpected football match between Sweden and Norway. With over 20,000 spectators in the stands, the match became a massive talking point and put Sporttouchen on the map as a new phenomenon in the world of sports and entertainment. This time, Tim is determined to surpass last year’s success. He is hunting for the perfect squad, planning halftime shows featuring world-class artists, and dreaming of the ultimate signing: getting Zlatan to pull on the Swedish jersey once again. Yet, at the heart of it all is Tim himself, the man who built an entire sports channel from the ground up. How did he get here? And what is he willing to sacrifice to outdo himself?

results.title: On To The Next
results.overview: Matthew moves out of his apartment complex at UC Irvine only to be met with a ghost of himself roaming his room.

results.title: Black Soil
results.overview: In this portrait of the enduring contributions of Black farmers, Herbert Allen Jr. and his son, Trentis carry their family legacy forward as they steward the land with regenerative practices in the Mississippi Delta.

results.title: Her Only Way Out
results.overview: After surviving a terrifying crash and being coerced into silence, a woman realizes the only way to escape is to stage her own death and disappear completely.

results.title: My Dear Stranger
results.overview: Vennela after a major accident goes through trauma and is unable to come out of it , who later meets Surya who attempts to bring joy into her life .

results.title: Rusambo
results.overview: Ru$ambo follows the journey of Hanayashe, a Shona bride whose lobola ceremony unravels into a maze of accusations and secrets when the bride price mysteriously disappears. With the marriage now in limbo, Hanayashe is forced to confront a painful truth: someone within her trusted circle has sabotaged her big day. To reclaim her future, she must untangle the motives of her family and close friends, exposing hidden agendas, fractured loyalties, and long-buried tensions. Inspired by whodunnit-style mysteries and African folktales of tricksters and betrayals, Ru$ambo transforms a seemingly straightforward theft into a gripping tale of suspicion, deception, and cultural reckoning.

results.title: The Train
results.overview: **The Train** follows Tharun, a young man whose ordinary train journey takes an unexpected turn when a seemingly simple encounter forces him to confront something he has been avoiding. Set against the rhythm of a local train, the film explores loneliness, human connection, and the fleeting moments that can change the way we see ourselves and the people around us. Sometimes, the most important journeys are the ones we never planned.

results.title: Mimic
results.overview: A little girl with echolalia is left home alone at night with her mother, whom she no longer recognizes.

results.title: The Golden Years of Dario Argento
results.original_title: Gli anni d'oro di Dario Argento
results.overview: An in-depth interview with the master of giallo, Dario Argento, about his career and his masterpieces: from The Bird with the Crystal Plumage (1970) to Insomnia (2001).

results.title: The Soulless
results.overview: Two high-school bookworms lure their bullies into a forest to expel the bad from their souls, only to end up face to face with something far worse.
